jobs.occupation: Equipment Engineer (m/w/d) (Open) (Elektroniker/in - Automatisierungs- und Systemtechnik)
jobs.description:
Job Description

As an Equipment Engineer within the EGIO area, you will be responsible for ensuring the technical availability, performance, and continuous improvement of highly complex production equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. Leveraging your expertise in implantation, epitaxy, glass-processing technologies, and furnace systems, you will play a key role in maintaining stable, quality-compliant, and cost-efficient manufacturing processes while meeting the highest standards of safety, quality, and productivity. Through proactive problem-solving, equipment optimization, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will contribute directly to manufacturing excellence, product quality, and the company's overall competitiveness.

You will join a highly skilled and interdisciplinary team of approximately 40 engineers, technicians, and support specialists. Our working environment is built on openness, trust, and collaborative teamwork, providing an atmosphere where technical expertise is valued, innovation is encouraged, and both professional and personal development can thrive.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Ownership

- Provide technical support, optimization, and further development of production equipment within the EGIO area (Epitaxy, Glass Processes, Implantation, and Furnaces).
- Ensure high equipment availability and process stability.
- Conduct fault analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Coordinate and oversee preventive maintenance and repair activities.

Process and Quality Optimization

- Analyze equipment and process data to identify improvement opportunities.
- Develop and implement initiatives to improve: - OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
- MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
- MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)
- Process Capability (Cp/Cpk)
- Yield and Product Quality
- Perform statistical analyses and root-cause investigations.
- Support the qualification of new processes, products, and equipment upgrades.

Project Management

- Lead and participate in cross-functional improvement projects.
- Plan and implement equipment upgrades and retrofit programs.
- Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and external service providers.
- Prepare technical specifications and requirement documents.

Production Support

- Support escalation management within the manufacturing environment.
- Deliver technical training for operators and maintenance technicians.

Other Responsibilities

- Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality standards.
- Maintain equipment performance in line with production targets.
- Reduce unplanned equipment downtime.
- Document technical modifications and engineering changes.
- Support audits and ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in one of the following disciplines:

- Electrical/ Mechanical/ Microsystems/Process Engineering
- Physics
- Materials Science
- Or a comparable technical field

Professional Experience

- Minimum 3 years of experience in the semiconductor industry or a comparable high-tech manufacturing environment.
- Practical experience in at least one of the EGIO responsibility areas.

Technical Expertise

- Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
- Knowledge of SPC (Statistical Process Control), FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and data analytics.
- Experience with MES and ERP systems.
- Familiarity with vacuum technology, high-temperature processes, gas delivery systems, and cleanroom technologies.
- Ability to interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and engineering specifications.

Personal Competencies

- Strong analytical and structured approach to problem-solving.
- High level of initiative and ownership.
- Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.
- Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.
- Resilience and flexibility in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
- Continuous Improvement mindset.

Language Skills

- Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.
- Ability to communicate effectively with international suppliers and development partners.

We are seeking a high-energy, detail-oriented Supply Chain & Quality Manager (SCQM) to take the lead in managing the quality, compliance, and industrial readiness of our global cabin seating suppliers.

If you are a proactive manager who loves the thrill of fast-paced industrializations, custom designs, and zero-defect executions, this is your ultimate career destination!

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Act as focal point towards the suppliers for operational activities and contract management, and as ambassador of the supplier toward internal functions..
- Perform an effective control of supplier activities, securing a close understanding of the delivery and quality conformity of the product
- Implement recovery, improvement and development plan in order to secure delivery of the products and services in conformity covering quality, delivery.
- Coordinate the stakeholders involved in the supplier operations management and contribute to the corresponding Multi-Functional or Divisional Team (MFT) Manage/contribute to supplier On Quality On Time (OQOT) performance.
- Manage supplier quality Approval/Authorization, ensure that suppliers are compliant with certifications required in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
- Managing suppliers’ quality recoveries and following-up of the quality actions plan of the suppliers via root cause analysis (RCA) 9S / PPS problem solving methodologies

Desired skills and qualifications

Key Skills & Competencies

- Autonomy & Proactivity: High degree of autonomy, initiative, rigor, reactivity, and eagerness to learn
- Stakeholder Management & Collaboration: Strong cross-functional stakeholder management, effective team spirit, and working beyond functional boundaries
- Communication & Negotiation: Excellent communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills with the ability to resolve conflicts constructively
- Problem Solving & Risk Mitigation: Proven track record in solving quality problems, anticipating and mitigating risks, and managing uncertainty across complex scenarios

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

- Education: Engineering or other relevant technical degree. Professional Experience: At least 4 years of experience, ideally in Quality, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, or Production
- Domain Background: Industrial background—specifically in Manufacturing Engineering or Quality—is a strong plus. Experience in Cabin perimeter is highly appreciated
- Languages: Business/negotiation fluency in English; proficiency in French and/or German is an asset

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

- Duration: 12 months with the possibility to prolong the contract

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Job DescriptionHVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor (m/f/d)

GE Vernova is facing a momentum of hypergrowth, and we are currently scaling up our teams, creating others from scratch, and bringing our industry to the next level. Join us on this mission!

At GE Vernova Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Vernova Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral.

Due to the growth of our HVDC business, we are currently looking for our next HVDC Primary & Valve Installation Supervisor in the “Construction & Commissioning” function to participate in this energy transition.

Your Mission: Within our large scale HVDC Projects you are responsible for the Supervision of the Installation for our HVDC Valves including the Valve Cooling System. The installation will be done by subcontractors.

This position implies functional leadership as an IC (Individual Contributor) without direct reports. It is a Construction Site based role.

Join us and enjoy playing a major role to enhance the Central Europe Construction & Commissioning function with fresh ideas!

Why we come to work:

At GE Vernova, our employees are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.
Main Tasks/Responsibilities:

1. EHS
Ensure all installation activities are performed in accordance with safety protocols and regulatory requirements.
2. Quality Oversight
Implement quality control measures to ensure the reliability and performance of installed HVDC Valves & HVDC Primary Equipment.
Conduct inspections based on ITPs to verify adherence to quality standards.
Prepare and review installation documentation, test reports, and as-built drawings.
Ensure all tools, equipment, and materials are properly maintained and stored
3. Planning & Coordination

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher CMS Experiment (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Postdoctoral Researcher CMS Experiment

Remuneration Group 13 | Limited: 5 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: FHPO009/2026 | Deadline: 24.09.2026 | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The CMS DESY group is based in Hamburg and is one of the largest groups worldwide participating in the CMS Experiment at CERN. The successful candidate will join a newly established Helmholtz Investigator Group at DESY, working within the CMS Collaboration to study how top quarks interact with the heavy bosons (W, Z, and Higgs) at the highest energies reached at the LHC. Using the full CMS dataset, the project targets these interactions in the boosted regime and interprets the measurements in the framework of Effective Field Theory, searching for subtle deviations from the Standard Model that could point to new physics. The work combines advanced jet reconstruction and identification with modern machine-learning techniques, offering the opportunity to develop expertise at the interface of experimental data analysis and cutting-edge ML methods.

About your role:

- Develop and apply advanced jet reconstruction and machine-learning techniques for the identification of boosted top quarks and heavy bosons, forming the methodological foundation shared across the group's measurements.
- Take a leading role in the unfolding of the differential cross-section measurements and in the global Effective Field Theory interpretation combining them into constraints on top-boson couplings.
- Co-supervise the group's PhD students and help shape the strategic direction of the measurement methods and analysis setup, ensuring continuity and knowledge transfer across the staggered projects.
- Contribute to CMS service and object-performance tasks.
- Represent the group within the CMS Collaboration and at international conferences, with the possibility of regular short-term research stays at CERN.

About you:

- PhD in experimental particle physics, completed or nearing completion.
- Demonstrated experience with machine-learning methods in high-energy physics, ideally applied to jet or boosted-object reconstruction and identification.
- Experience with differential cross-section measurements and unfolding techniques; familiarity with Effective Field Theory interpretations is an advantage.
- Strong scientific programming skills (e.g. Python and C++) and experience with modern ML frameworks; knowledge of the CMS software environment is beneficial.
- Ability to work both independently and within a team, to support and mentor students, and to communicate results effectively in English.
- Experience in supervising students is a bonus.
- lnterest in outreach activities is advantageous.
- Experience with global fits is a plus.

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information please contact Dr. Anna Benecke, anna.benecke@desy.de.

Please arrange for three letters of reference to be sent to the DESY human resource department by using our online tool: Additional application documents (https://www.desy.de/career/additional_application_documents/index_eng.html)

We look forward to receiving your application (letter of motivation, CV and relevant certificates) via our application portal:

DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://www.desy.de/career/working_at_desy/what_we_offer/diversity__inclusion/index_eng.html) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women (https://www.desy.de/career/working_at_desy/what_we_offer/equal_opportunities/index_eng.html)  is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position.
